_note: Food and drink (core/food.gd, spec docs/specs/food-drink.md). Race tables and market mapping only; every numeric rule lives in core/food.gd as a tagged constant. fav_drink: [beer %, wine %] at recruitment. enemy_buzz: buzz range rolled at battle spawn. beast: belly only (no buzz, no drink need). goods: which town market good (campaign/goods.gd, data/economy.json) a company stock item is drawn from, and how many come out of one unit of it (economy units are meals, mugs and cups: 1 each; "food" = grain, fruit and meat together).
